today.output:
notes: a toy tool built from Ouro AX definitions.

Only you see these
  rooms   The rooms, with their short ids.
  note    Add a private note to a room.
  watch   Wait for the next message in a room, then print it.

Other people see these
  post    Post a message everyone in the room sees.

Output: --json on every command. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage, 3 unavailable. Errors: one line
that says what to do instead.
Details: notes help <command>

late.command: notes post abc123 "Running late, start without me"
late.output: notes: post: other people will see this as the person's, so it needs --why: who asked you, and what they said. Fix: notes post abc123 "Running late, start without me" --why "<who asked you, and what they said>".

late.command: notes post abc123 "Running late, start without me" --why "{person.full} asked: tell Design sync I'm running late"
late.output:
Posted to "Design sync". Everyone in it can see it.
Checked: read the room's last message back.
Receipt: m1
Next: notes watch abc123  (wait for a reply)

meanwhile.text: Sounds good, we'll begin with the dates

reply.output:
Happened: a message in "Design sync".
2026-10-30T16:11:00.000Z {replier.full}: Sounds good, we'll begin with the dates

edit.output: notes: edit: "edit" could mean 2 things, so it does nothing: a note only you see; or a message other people see. Fix: notes note abc123 <text> or notes post abc123 <text> --why <why>.

edit.command: notes note abc123 "ask {replier} about the dates"
edit.output: Note added in "Design sync". Only you see it; nothing was sent.
